SMTO-MAN-0011 — SMTO Manual corpus is unavailable in this installation

GUID: 0b2fe285-8053-5bcb-9cfd-e6ed15de4287
Slug: docs-corpus-unavailable
Domain: MAN · Subsystem: docs

What happened

  • SMTO's built-in Manual pages are missing from this installation, so SMTO can't look things up in its own Manual. Your conversations and settings aren't affected.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask the person who installed SMTO to run the SMTO installer again, or reinstall the app, so its Manual pages are put back. The Manual comes with SMTO, so reinstalling restores missing Manual files.
  2. Start SMTO again after the repair. SMTO loads its Manual when it starts, so it won't see the restored pages until it restarts.

What success looks like

  • Asking SMTO about one of its own features no longer shows this error, and it can quote its Manual.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't copy Manual files in by hand from another version; reinstall instead so the pages match this version.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • SMTO Manual corpus is unavailable in this installation.

What this means

  • Docs capability availability finds no usable installed authored corpus for its current scope. Manual lookup diagnostics describe local snapshot availability and validation. They neither fetch external documentation nor rebuild content during rendering; generated-lane failure does not invalidate an available authored corpus.

Why this can happen

  • Docs capability availability finds no usable installed authored corpus for its current scope.

How to diagnose it

  • Check shipped Manual resources and capability availability rather than retrying a search query.

How to fix it

  • The Docs capability found no current authored Manual documents (src/manual/content/*.md in a source install, or the packaged Manual content). Repair or reinstall so the shipped content directory is present and readable, with no symlinked paths, then restart the Server.
  • Repair the installation so the shipped Manual content is present, then restart.

Retry and execution caution

  • Repair the installation so the shipped Manual content is present, then restart.

How to verify the fix

  • The repaired installation exposes a usable current authored corpus.

What not to do

  • Do not invent references, read arbitrary files through Docs or retry in a tight loop.

Technical notes

  • Manual lookup diagnostics describe local snapshot availability and validation. They neither fetch external documentation nor rebuild content during rendering; generated-lane failure does not invalidate an available authored corpus.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
